arguments.text: Milestone complete: implemented and locally verified evaluate(request, policy) plus report.json. Tests passed for layer ordering, false/zero/empty preservation, null reset behavior, deferred exact type validation, bool-not-integer, strict boolean/integer environment parsing, environment gating, unknown keys, and report consistency. Remaining model limits: raw arbitrary requests require externally classified evidence tokens in the executable model, and combined-error precedence is not exhaustively modeled, though implementation behavior was checked.
